news.analysis: Henry found the end zone for the first time since Week 4 against the Titans. With Lamar Jackson (thumb) headed to IR and Tyler Huntley's (toe) status uncertain for Week 9, Henry could be in line for a lot of work against the Jaguars in Week 9.
news.contents: Derrick Henry rushed for 53 yards and a touchdown on 11 carries in a 36-10 loss to the Bills. He caught both of his targets for seven yards.
news.title: Derrick Henry finds the end zone in Week 8 loss

news.contents: Baltimore Ravens running back Derrick Henry currently leads the NFL in rushing attempts (147) and ranks sixth in the league in rushing yardage (579). He is tied for third in the NFL in rushing touchdowns (seven). However, Henry is currently averaging a career-low 3.9 yards per carry, and he has rushed for under 60 yards in each of his last two games. He rushed for a season-low 45 yards in a Week 7 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals. However, with starting quarterback Lamar Jackson back, things ...
news.title: Derrick Henry Looks to Get Back on Track in Matchup Vs. Bills

news.analysis: Tuten turned in the first 100-yard rushing performance of his career on Sunday while also setting a new personal best in receiving yards. The second-year speedster has now scored twice in both of the Jaguars' last two games and is up to six total touchdowns - three rushing, three receiving - for the campaign. Tuten is quickly inserting himself among the league's most potent dual-threat weapons at his position, as he's averaging nearly 18 touches and over 96 yards of offense per game.
news.contents: Bhayshul Tuten went for 104 yards and a touchdown on 16 carries, adding in two receptions for 55 yards and another score in Sunday's 42-7 blowout of the Colts.
news.title: Bhayshul Tuten gashes Colts in Week 8 rout

news.analysis: Judkins was completely stifled on the ground all afternoon. He will look to bounce back as an RB2 play next week against the Saints.
news.contents: Quinshon Judkins ran for 25 yards on 11 carries in the Browns 27-6 loss against the Steelers. He also caught 2-of-2 targets for 24 yards receiving.
news.title: Quinshon Judkins shut down on ground Sunday

news.contents: Cleveland Browns running back Quinshon Judkins was one of many players on his team to disappoint in Week 8, recording just 49 yards from scrimmage on 13 touches in Cleveland's 27-6 loss to the Pittsburgh Steelers. Judkins came into the game off his best performance of the season, logging 104 scrimmage yards and two touchdowns on 18 touches against the Tennessee Titans in Week 7. However, the Browns fell behind early on Sunday against Pittsburgh, leading to a pass-heavy game script. As a result,...
news.title: Quinshon Judkins Loses Receiving Work in Rough Week 8 Showing

news.analysis: Smith-Njigba was by far Seattle's leading receiver on Monday night, finishing with 92 more yards than their second highest contributor. He was also able to get into the end zone again and finished with a terrific fantasy total, which just adds to the insane pace that he has established over the first half of the season.
news.contents: Jaxon Smith-Njigba hauled in 6-of-11 targets for 118 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 34-17 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba stellar in loss Monday

news.contents: Seattle Seahawks wide receiver Jaxon Smith-Njigba caught six passes for 118 yards and a touchdown on 11 targets in Monday night's 34-17 home loss to the Chicago Bears. Smith-Njigba shone again despite quarterback Sam Darnold struggling to a 50% completion rate against a new-look Bears defense. It's the seventh time in 2026 that the fourth-year pro has surpassed 100 receiving yards, and his sixth outing with 11 or more targets. No other Seattle pass catcher gained more than 26 yards or had more...
news.title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba Delivers Another Huge Effort in Loss

news.analysis: Wilson led the team in targets and was second on the team in receptions and receiving yards. This marked his second highest target total of the season, which he needed after being targeted just three times last week. Wilson and the Jets will travel to Kansas City in Week 9.
news.contents: Garrett Wilson caught 6-of-12 targets for 83 yards in a 38-33 loss to the Raiders.
news.title: Garrett Wilson hauls in six passes in Week 8

news.contents: New York Jets wide receiver Garrett Wilson is a WR2 for Sunday's Week 8 home matchup against the Las Vegas Raiders, but the recent distribution of targets lowers confidence in a rebound. Wilson received only three of Geno Smith's 30 attempts against Miami, catching two passes for 26 yards while Smith threw three touchdowns. Across Weeks 6-7, Wilson accounted for 12.2% of New York's first-read targets, compared with 29.3% for Omar Cooper Jr. That shift matters because Wilson's disappointing ...
news.title: Garrett Wilson's Recent Target Share Adds Risk to WR2 Outlook

news.analysis: Myers missed two kicks on Monday night. One of them wasn't his fault, as it was blocked by Chicago, but there were still four points left out on the field by the veteran kicker. He isn't expected to be among the top kickers in fantasy over the back half of the season.
news.contents: Jason Myers went 1-for-2 on his field-goal attempt and missed his lone extra-point attempt in Monday night's 34-17 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.title: Jason Myers misses two kicks in loss Monday

news.contents: Seattle Seahawks kicker Jason Myers should be a strong play in Week 8 against the Chicago Bears. Myers is the K8 heading into this game. He has been a consistent producer in the seven- to eight-point range in fantasy. Myers' superpower has been his accuracy. He has only missed two total kicks this season, and the Seahawks have been kicking more field goals in recent weeks, leading to more fantasy points for Myers. No matter what, the Seahawks should be in scoring position plenty of times ...
news.title: Jason Myers a Strong Play in Week 8

news.analysis: Diaby went down with an injury in the Bucs win over Atlanta, and had an MRI today to determine the extent. And while he will miss time, it's good that it's nothing incredibly serious or season-ending.
news.contents: Yaya Diaby (knee) has a Grade 2 MCL sprain and is expected to miss a couple of weeks, but not extended time.
news.title: Yaya Diaby (knee) has sprained MCL, expected to miss a couple of weeks

news.analysis: The Lions added that preliminary indications are positive for Campbell, a positive sign for the Lions linebacker.
news.contents: The Lions say LB Jack Campbell continues to rest and recover at a local hospital.
news.title: Jack Campbell (neck) remains in hospital Monday

news.analysis: Willis now has six passing touchdowns to five interceptions on the season, and his season-high in passing yardage is 220 yards, set back in Week 1. The rushing upside is there; we've seen it each of the two weeks prior to this one, but in games like Sunday's, it completely evaporates. He's usable as a QB2, but the hope for a modest passing season with prolific rushing numbers is seeming unlikely.
news.contents: Malik Willis completed 21-of-32 passes for 211 yards with two touchdowns and a pick in the Dolphins' 24-19 win over the Patriots. He ran once for two yards.
news.title: Malik Willis tosses two touchdowns in loss to Patriots

news.analysis: Hampton hasn't been able to get anything going over the course of the season, and Sunday was no exception. He totaled just 27 yards on his 11 touches and wasn't able to get into the end zone at all, which left him with a terrible fantasy total. He should not be started in nearly any league formats for the foreseeable future.
news.contents: Omarion Hampton rushed the ball nine times for 20 yards and caught two passes for seven yards in Sunday's 24-9 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.title: Omarion Hampton disappoints again in loss Sunday

news.contents: Los Angeles Chargers running back Omarion Hampton was hopeful for better results coming out of the bye week, but that wasn't the case on Sunday. Hampton continues to struggle to find any room to run and was once again unsuccessful on Sunday. The 23-year-old carried the ball nine times for 20 yards and hauled in two receptions for seven yards in the loss to the Los Angeles Rams. Hampton is really struggling right now and hasn't surpassed 35 rushing yards in a single game since Week 4. At this ...
news.title: Omarion Hampton Continues to Struggle

news.analysis: Odunze looked good on Monday night. He led the team with 87 yards on four catches, although he wasn't able to get into the end zone at all, which left him with a limited fantasy total. He will likely have some boom games here and there moving forward, but it remains difficult to trust starting him on an every-week basis at this point.
news.contents: Rome Odunze caught 4-of-6 targets for 87 yards in Monday night's 34-17 win over the Seattle Seahawks.
news.title: Rome Odunze leads team in receiving Monday

Bourne has operated as Arizona's WR2 since the team traded away wideout Marvin Harrison Jr. to the Houston Texans in mid-October, recording 14 catches for 155 yards on 24 targets over his last four games. Fellow top Arizona wideout Michael Wilson (ribs) is also playing through ...

news.analysis: Strange had the longest gain of his career Sunday, as he went 46 yards on QB Trevor Lawrence's first pass of the game. Lawrence only completed 10 passes in this contest, so Strange and the rest of the Jaguars route runners didn't deliver huge production for fantasy managers. In fact, Strange was one of three Jaguars to tie for the team lead in receptions. He also tied running back Bhayshul Tuten for the team lead in receiving yards. Strange is having a solid season, but the Jaguars run a largely balanced attack, with Lawrence spreading the ball around to a variety of targets.
news.contents: Brenton Strange caught both of his targets for 55 yards in Sunday's 42-7 win over the Colts.
news.title: Brenton Strange goes for 55 receiving yards on Sunday

news.contents: In a week that saw Jaguars quarterbacks attempt only 17 passes in a blowout win over the Colts, Jacksonville tight end Brenton Strange tied for the team lead with 55 receiving yards on his two receptions. With the passing offense becoming slightly unpredictable through its embarrassment of riches, Strange has emerged as one of the Jaguars' most consistent fantasy producers, topping 40 receiving yards in his last four outings and ranking as the TE13 by points per game over that stretch despite ...
news.title: Brenton Strange a Consistently Safe Streamer with Untapped Upside

news.analysis: Douglas came back down to earth on Sunday, though a four for 43 yards is just fine in real life for a rookie. His efficiency had been insane, so it was bound to come down at some point. He's going to have a better matchup next week against the Lions and could be a flex play in that spot.
